name: Homeschool
overview: Scripture emphasizes the vital role of parents in guiding their children in the fear and knowledge of the Lord, as seen in commands to love God wholeheartedly (Deuteronomy 6:5) and to choose to serve Him faithfully as a family (Joshua 24:15). The Bible instructs parents to provide consistent instruction and nurture rooted in God's Word (Proverbs 1:8; Ephesians 6:4), training children in the way they should go so they will remain steadfast in their faith throughout life (Proverbs 22:6). When wisdom is needed to fulfill this responsibility, God promises to generously provide it to those who ask (James 1:5).
